title: Crash reconciliation services
description: Objective: implement safe-boundary drain, release/resume, absent-process recovery, suspect effect handling, and doctor recovery commands. Deliverable: focused runner recovery and daemon recovery modules. NOT in scope: timer-only ownership theft, disaster restore, graph supersession, or optimistic adoption. Hard dependencies: Lease presence core, Projection outbox core, External effect supervisor, Deterministic context journal, and Independent review flow. Owned paths: packages/runner/src/recovery/** and apps/daemon/src/recovery/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/runner test && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test.
definitionOfDone: No successor overlaps a predecessor lacking a proven safe release boundary.
Every injected crash yields adopted, absent, suspect, quarantined, or an exact reconciliation command; nothing silently resumes.
Quiet presence alone cannot steal ownership and late observations cannot advance stale authority.
Both focused runner and daemon test commands exit 0.
taskRails: Follow the pinned design; this task cannot create authority beyond its named contract.
Fail closed with stable codes and immutable deterministic outputs.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400.
Use TDD and stage only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, or merge.
